name: Portugal
shortSummary: India and Portugal share a complex colonial history — Goa remained under Portuguese rule until 1961 — but relations today are warm, with Portugal often serving as a bridge for India-EU engagement.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Portugal has positioned itself as a supportive voice for India's engagement with the European Union.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
